new_value: {"notes":"Implemented a fixed-capacity, allocation-free frame pool (4 x 256-byte buffers) with generation-tagged handles, stale/double-release rejection, zero-on-release, thread-safe acquire/get/release, explicit -ENOBUFS, and busy-destroy protection. Integrated TX queue entries with pool ownership across push/preemption/pop/expiry/clear/destroy and removed the unused duplicate tx_queue from lichen_link_ctx so constrained targets keep only the active radio queue's storage. Added dedicated boundary/generation/wrap/zeroization/concurrency tests and queue ownership lifecycle coverage.
